title: Attribute Controlled Fine-tuning for Large Language Models: A Case Study on Detoxification

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text generated by the model in response to prompts from the RealToxicPrompts and ToxiGen datasets. The methodology involves measuring average toxicity scores using the PerspectiveAPI and calculating the percentage of toxic generations using a pre-trained ToxiGen RoBERTa classifier. It also includes evaluating the model's ability to classify toxic comments using the Jigsaw dataset.
